dialogues.speaker: Innokenty
dialogues.text: An official letter sent here from Novokitezhgrad. I am a civil servant working at Zapolyarny Palace, and I'm mainly responsible for handling administrative matters relating to the city.

dialogues.speaker: Innokenty
dialogues.text: But— just look at all the fae words littered all over the place! Look at those dratted Domovoy nobles, insisting on using that archaic fae tongue even in this day and age, just so nobody forgets they're born of an ancient bloodline!

dialogues.speaker: Innokenty
dialogues.text: I even took the trouble to consult the learned Mr. Ovsyannikov to try to understand the letter. But even he couldn't make head or tail of it in the end!

dialogues.speaker: Innokenty
dialogues.text: By the Tsaritsa, even he can't read it and he's a Domovoy! So what am I supposed to do about it???
